audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer rows 0-5 all read 'Skill' while the content layer and packet read Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Orianna. Five rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Across the Veil is unavailable at levels 1-2, so Orianna's 815-range ball owns those levels outright. From 4-5 that 22s leap into invisibility sidesteps a telegraphed Shockwave and wins extended trades, and Between Worlds at 6 adds a slow zone she teleports across. Two items later Shockwave's multi-catch beats a single-target skirmisher.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 moved onto the content/packet values with every why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes credited Orianna with the level 6 spike using two unsourced magnitudes.
audit.why: Between Worlds on 140/120/100 is Aurora's spike; Orianna's spike here is Luden's restoring shove and rotation tempo.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Abjuration was never described: her spells and attacks exorcise spirits that follow her and heal her, so chip poke funds her sustain. breakdown.cooldowns held no digit. The content layer also repeatedly calls her W 'Spirit Abjuration' — that is the passive; the W is Across the Veil.
audit.why: Anti-heal timing decides every extended trade in this lane, and the leap's 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown is the number that decides when Orianna may step up at all. The Weirding adds a 15s slow that hops her backward, so she disengages the moment your ball commits.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d states the Grievous Wounds requirement, 'ahead' names it as a purchase, breakdown.cooldowns carries 22s and 15s, and the mislabelled ability name is fixed in the two content fields where it appears alongside an edit I was already making.
